name: autonomous-market-os
description: Autonomous Market OS is a paper-only quantitative market-research and portfolio-inspection workspace. Market OS owns quantitative math, probability, stability, calibration, risk, and paper decisions; Jev's intended role is advisory evidence assessment, but authentic local Jev remains unverified. Public market-data capture and synthetic hosted-Jev connectivity require bounded explicit opt-in. BTC evidence packets stay local; live trading and public mutation routes are disabled.
